release_notes: FIREWALL: open the FULL production port map on install (previously installers only opened a subset, so the test server couldn't reach many services). Now matches live server firewall-cmd --list-ports exactly across install_debian.sh, installer/install.sh (RHEL) and scripts/firewall.sh: web 20/21/22/26/80/443/990; DNS 53 tcp+udp; DB 3306; ManageSieve 4190; dashboard 5000/5001; panel 2082/2083/2086/2087/2089/2096/2097/2100/2101; streaming engines 8000/8001/8002/8004/8080/8081; media ranges 10000-10999 (DJ), 11000-11999 (SHOUTcast v1), 12000-13999 (v2), 14000-15999 (Icecast), 16000-16499 (AutoDJ), 17000-17999 (RTMP), 18000-18999 (RTSP), 19000-19999 (WebRTC ctrl), 20000-20999 (audio relay); games 25560-25660 / 27000-28000 / 30000-50000; WebRTC UDP 50000-55000. Includes iptables fallback rules.
